Introduction.body:
UniOS is a custom Linux distribution built specifically to be used by students & staff at all Greek Universities.

It is based on Kubuntu and ships with a carefully selected set of tools for academic work, programming, and everyday use, all pre-configured so you can get started without any manual setup. It's developed and maintained by the Open Source UoM community.

Features.body:
• KDE Plasma desktop, preconfigured with a clean academic theme
• UniBackpack integration for installing additional software
• Greek and English language support
• Lightweight footprint - runs well on older hardware

Community.body:
UniOS is built by students, for students.

Join the Open Source UoM community to:
• Get help and support from fellow students
• Share tips, tweaks, and configurations
• Participate in workshops and coding events
• Stay updated on new releases and features

You can find us on Discord — the invite link is in the footer.
Everyone is welcome, regardless of experience level.

Source Code.body:
UniOS is fully open source.

All build scripts and code for the apps are publicly available on GitHub under an open license.

Repositories:
• UniOS - The Linux distro you are currently using.
• UniBackpack - software installer tool for all Universities.
• UniMate - A Webpage that helps you install various Linux apps.
• UniDesk - this desktop launcher app.

Feel free to fork, study, and adapt the code for your own projects. Pull requests and bug reports are always welcome.

Contribute.body:
Want to help build UniOS? There are many ways to contribute:

• Code - fix bugs, add features, improve scripts
• Design - UI/UX improvements, icons, wallpapers
• Documentation - write guides, translate content
• Testing - try new builds and report issues
• Community - help other students in Discord

No contribution is too small. Check our GitHub repositories to get started.
